note: General RV park (not equestrian-only) at 2492 Dilmore Rd, Cottondale, off I-10 Exit 130. Takes overnight and extended stays. Has a private lake and two ponds for fishing, two dog parks and a petting farm. The owner suggests asking for sites farther from I-10 (guests often prefer 5-8) for a quieter night. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's site: 26 full-hookup 20/30/50-amp sites, mostly pull-through to 100 ft, free Wi-Fi, Good Sam/Passport America/military discounts. Changed: base rate added ($30 'starting at'), booking is by phone with the owner (not online); note's '~$45/night' and 'Reservable online' dropped as contradicted. Not stated: season (only 'open 24/7').
